t: This is St Luke Old Street, a Grade I listed church in Islington. It served as a parish church from 1733 to 1959. It was designed by John James together with Nicholas Hawksmoor. James is particularly associated with Twickenham, in west London, where he rebuilt St Mary's Church. One assessment of his work calls him a competent architect who lacked inventive fancy, with buildings that are mostly plain and unadventurous. Here he worked alongside a far better-known name.
